negative_controls.reason: A proposed instrument is mutated to appear in force and satisfy a binding legal obligation.
A source from one destination market is used to satisfy a different destination market.
A vehicle or component requirement is applied to a different product category without evidence.
A superseded or expired source is treated as current after its validity ended.
A 1998 Agreement GTR is treated as mutual recognition of approval, or a 1958 approval is assumed recognized by a party that does not apply that UN Regulation.
Supplier-site jurisdiction is substituted for material origin or legally relevant transformation evidence.
Unknown origin or customs classification is treated as qualifying for preference or local-content benefit.
Missing, stale or unknown evidence is converted to a satisfied disposition.
Data processing or cross-border transfer jurisdiction is omitted from the deployment context.
A regional profile silently changes the shared engineering product revision or digest.
Unknown customs classification is used to claim a preferential or quota rate.
Supplier or material origin is assigned preference eligibility without the applicable origin rule and transformation evidence.
The entity or actor responsible for conformity, import or placing on market is mismatched to the obligation.
A requirement or temporary tariff/quota is applied outside its effective/transition/expiry window.
A local-content percentage or incentive claim is made without a named method, numerator, denominator and supporting evidence.
